text: Ten-year school reunion. The name badges are doing a lot of work.

right.label: Go
right.result: The coolest kid in school sells insurance now, and is thrilled about it.

risk.result: The speech did not go the way it did in the shower.

text: Third wedding this summer. You own one suit and it knows every dance floor in town.

up.label: Do the dance with the aunt

risk.result: The aunt does not let go.

text: Your friend hands you their newborn without warning. It's looking at you.

right.label: Hold it properly
right.result: It's sick on your shoulder. You've been accepted.

risk.result: The baby has opinions about sleep.

text: You bent down to tie a shoelace and something in your back said no.

risk.result: A week on the floor, looking at the ceiling.
It aggravates the back.

text: You stayed up past midnight once. You've been paying for it since Thursday.

risk.result: Your body files a complaint.

text: It's Sunday night and you already dread Monday. You've been dreading it for six years.

risk.result: The plan arrives later than the rent.

text: A colleague tells you what they earn. It's more than you, for the same job.

risk.result: "Budgets are tight this year." Your boss's car is new.
They say go on then.

text: An old classmate messages you. They have a business opportunity, and you could be your own boss.

risk.result: You now own a garage full of vitamin shakes.
The box arrives. It is empty.

text: The landlord is raising the rent, and calls it "exciting news".

risk.result: He has six other people waiting.
You do not, in fact, have anywhere to move.

text: Your neighbour has taken up the drums. It's going badly and it's going nightly.

right.label: Knock on the door

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

right.result: They apologise, then invite you to the gig.

risk.result: You are now the worst drummer in the street.

text: Your friend just got a new car on finance. The payments are "basically nothing".

right.label: Sign the papers
right.result: It smells incredible for about a month.

risk.result: The payments are not basically nothing.

text: A parent had a fall. They say it's nothing and they'd rather you didn't fuss.

right.label: Drive over and fuss
right.result: You fix the loose rug. Nobody mentions it again.

risk.result: They're very polite about it. Everyone is tense.

text: The doctor says your numbers are "fine for now". You don't enjoy the "for now".

risk.result: Three weeks of kale. The kale wins.

text: You and your closest friend now only talk about how you never talk.

risk.result: It rains for six days.

text: A glass of wine every night has quietly become two.

risk.result: The year is long. You wobble.

text: A friend mentions their therapist the way other people mention a good mechanic.

right.label: Book a session
right.result: You talk about the school play for fifty minutes.

risk.result: It stirs up more than you expected.

text: A colleague's doing a marathon and needs a partner for training. You own trainers.

risk.result: Your knee files a complaint at mile nine.
Somewhere around mile twenty you regret this.

death.cause: The heart gave out on the course.

text: A pottery class on Tuesdays. You'd finally have a hobby to mention.

right.label: Sign up
right.result: You make one bowl. It's mostly a hole.

up.label: Sell your pots at the market

risk.result: The market is not kind to pots.

text: You've been saying "one day" about that trip for ten years.

up.label: Take a sabbatical for the trip

risk.result: The job is not there when you return.

text: You find a wallet on the train with $300 and a photo of a very old dog.

risk.result: The owner is not grateful. The dog is.

text: Your workplace wants everyone to dress as vegetables for charity.

right.label: Be the leek

risk.result: There was a catch.

right.result: The photo stays on the office wall for eleven years.

risk.result: The leek costume was not made to be run in.

text: You find your first grey hair. It's thicker than the others and clearly in charge.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.
It went a different colour.

text: A teenager on the bus calls you "sir" or "ma'am". You look behind you.

risk.result: There was a catch.
They will tell all of their friends.

text: A friend wants you to co-sign a loan for their food truck. It's a very good truck.

risk.result: The truck is gone. The letters come to you.

up.label: Put the house up against it

risk.result: The truck did not make it past the first festival.

text: An online calculator tells you when you can retire. It says 94.

risk.result: You forget what fun was.

text: You look up someone from your past at 2am. You accidentally like a photo from 2011.

right.label: Own it

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.result: They like one of yours back. Neither of you ever speaks of it.

risk.result: They replied. It was awkward.

text: You've been called for jury duty. Three weeks in a beige room.

risk.result: The case drags on for weeks.

text: Your friend is moving abroad and asks you to take their rat, Margaret, "just for now".

right.label: Take Margaret
right.result: It is four years later. Margaret runs the place.

risk.result: They are not all Margaret.

text: You sat in the car outside work for forty minutes. You couldn't make yourself go in.

risk.result: Starting over turned out to cost money.

text: You could pay someone to clean the gutters, or you could trust this old ladder.

risk.result: The ladder had made up its mind.
The ladder was older than you thought.

death.cause: The ladder went one way. You went the other.
